title: RestoreVersion
description: Implement `RestoreVersion` (user only) in the service and Connect handler: take the snapshot at the requested revision from history, write it as a new revision with a `CHANGE_TYPE_RESTORED` entry (`restored_revision` set). Re-check the rules a restore could break (parent exists, no new cycles, ranks) and reject with FAILED_PRECONDITION if the old version no longer fits.
